sample_unit: cases (clinical and dermoscopic images with metadata)

links.outcome: Multiclass skin lesion diagnostic accuracy of AI models versus physician readers by experience level
links.effect: Experts with >10 years achieved 74.2% accuracy versus 56.7% CNN, 72.2% unimodal, 66.3% multimodal; AI did not beat the most experienced clinicians.
links.quote: With a mean (SD) accuracy of 74.2% (5.7%), experts with more than 10 years of experience achieved the highest multiclass diagnostic accuracy, outperforming all AI models on this primary end point, which included 56.7% (3.9%) for CNN, 72.2% (3.5%) for the unimodal model, and 66.3% (3.8%) for the multimodal model.

screen.reason: Multicenter reader study comparing AI models against physicians of varying expertise on realistic skin lesion cases without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
